messages.author: Xavier Brazzolotto
messages.body:
Dear AmberTools users
I do have an issue when trying to install on my Intel Mac (macOS Monterey 12.6)
Despite many warnings during the installation everything goes to 100% but end up with
[100%] Linking CXX executable metatwist
Undefined symbols for architecture x86_64:
"boost::iostreams::detail::bzip2_base::end(bool, std::nothrow_t)", referenced from:
boost::iostreams::symmetric_filter<boost::iostreams::detail::bzip2_decompressor_impl<std::__1::allocator<char> >, std::__1::allocator<char> >::symmetric_filter<bool>(long, bool const&) in metatwist.cpp.o
boost::detail::shared_count::shared_count<boost::iostreams::symmetric_filter<boost::iostreams::detail::bzip2_decompressor_impl<std::__1::allocator<char> >, std::__1::allocator<char> >::impl>(boost::iostreams::symmetric_filter<boost::iostreams::detail::bzip2_decompressor_impl<std::__1::allocator<char> >, std::__1::allocator<char> >::impl*) in metatwist.cpp.o
boost::detail::sp_counted_impl_p<boost::iostreams::symmetric_filter<boost::iostreams::detail::bzip2_decompressor_impl<std::__1::allocator<char> >, std::__1::allocator<char> >::impl>::dispose() in metatwist.cpp.o
ld: symbol(s) not found for architecture x86_64
clang: error: linker command failed with exit code 1 (use -v to see invocation)
make[2]: *** [AmberTools/src/moft/metatwist] Error 1
make[1]: *** [AmberTools/src/moft/CMakeFiles/metatwist.dir/all] Error 2
make: *** [all] Error 2
Any idea of what causing such issue ? Maybe I have to update something.
For information I am using gFortran 12.2.0 from Homebrew maybe it is the cause and Amber may prefer a gFortran 11 flavor ?
Xavier

messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Tue, Oct 18, 2022, Xavier Brazzolotto via AMBER wrote:
>
>I do have an issue when trying to install on my Intel Mac (macOS Monterey 12.6)
>
>[100%] Linking CXX executable metatwist
>Undefined symbols for architecture x86_64:
>  "boost::iostreams::detail::bzip2_base::end(bool, std::nothrow_t)", referenced from:
Look at the packaging report in the cmake.log file: are you getting boost
from internal or external sources?  If the latter, then adding this to your
run_cmake script should help:
-DFORCE_INTERNAL_LIBS="boost"
Or, a workaround would be this:
-DDISABLE_TOOLS="moft"
This will skip building metatwist.
...good luck...dac

messages.author: Xavier Brazzolotto
messages.body:
Hi David,
I’ve tried the -DFORCE_INTERNAL_LIBS="boost" as I have boost installed from Homebrew but it didn’t do the trick.
The second workaround did it and I’ve able to install AmberTools.
